args.title: Juniper Labware — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter (Juniper Labware, "Freight pricing this quarter"): This week's issue covers freight pricing for the quarter; it points to the full article on the Juniper blog and notes a companion piece is available to subscribers.
- Linked article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight): Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion, subscriber access via team code SUB-7378): Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
